Existing draw/release resources therefore do not constitute a reachable bow module. The visual findings have separate established causes: absent portrait resources, clothing deformation under the wrapper's lowered-arm pose, and unfinished menu/focus presentation.

tasks.instructions:
Bind this task to the frozen loop-08 candidate and PRD R04, sections 3.4, 4.2, 5.2, 6.1–6.4, 7.1 and appendix D.2. Complete Ronen's reachable bow handoff, brief demonstration and safe repeatable lesson using the current village and compatible actor/archery bindings. Place the interaction and target on validated ground with a usable approach, clear shooting lane, real nearby obstruction and safe return route. Equipment possession and learned behavior are independent facts; recognize legitimate early training contact and do not invent an additional unlock requirement. Provide actual aim/draw/release, first-contact settlement, charge-dependent results, one-arrow consumption per valid release, zero-arrow prevention, and an explicit free refill outside combat. Cancellation before release consumes nothing. Preserve sword switching, stowed equipment, hurt/death interruption and input-release gating. Integrate bow facts into automatic/manual saves, validation, old-save defaults, recovery and fresh-game reset; loading must clear obsolete projectiles, charge and feedback. Keep old-lamp and Q02 completion truthful rather than marking them complete.
Reuse existing feedback where suitable; distinguish release, straw contact, obstruction and miss with appropriate visible and audible cues. When arrows hit an existing damageable enemy, settle charge-dependent damage once through its authoritative result and retain reward ownership. Do not add another encounter or combat rule. Keep contextual Chinese prompts, compact ammunition, the right-side upward charge arc and shared bundled serif styles; hide internal percentages/state inventories unless justified as player information.
Treat pinned portrait debt this loop: verify absent live resources, inspect a bounded licensed local shortlist using the supplied zero-result portrait search as a baseline, and assess binding repair versus replacement. Bind suitable qualified illustrated art if available within authority; otherwise report the concrete resource limitation and retain failed 6.
